summary: Central Puerto S.A. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent: current report on Form 8-K) disclosing that it, together with wholly owned subsidiary Proener S.A.U., repurchased treasury shares under Article 64 et seq. of Argentina's Capital Markets Law No. 26,831 and CNV rules. On the BYMA on 11/05/2026, CPSA bought 120,000 ordinary book-entry shares (AR$1 par, one vote each) at an average AR$1,639.99 per share for AR$196,799,983 total, settling 11/11/2026; no NYSE purchases occurred. Buybacks stayed under 25% of the prior 90-business-day average daily volume. Watch remaining authorization capacity and ADR/ordinary price convergence.
